candidate_count_semantics: Capacity only: 119 different exact input strings with positive literal title assertions across test/main.js and test/title.js. Not gold, not a count of fully annotated entries, and not necessarily new relative to other sources or reviewed-full.json.

main.assertion_semantics: 32 deep.equal complete-object assertions, each with one literal releaseName input and a positive title. Preserve every original field, including contradictory or incomplete coverage declarations; no source-wide acceptance.

title.assertion_semantics: 82 releaseName declarations and 7 inline literal parse inputs. 87 positive title assertions (deep.include objects or direct title equality); 2 negative title inequalities do not establish an expected title and are excluded from candidate_count. One additional not.have.property languages assertion reuses the To Love-Ru input and adds no title candidate.

raw.semantics: Raw totals sum the two original files, excluding test-description strings. Literal input occurrences count releaseName declarations and inline parse input literals once; parse assertions additionally count the repeated language-property assertion. Exact-string union of positive title inputs is 119, with no cross-file duplicate positive input.

provenance.verification_method: Fetched the exact immutable Git commit; extracted test/main.js, test/title.js and LICENSE using git show. Verified all three SHA-256 values before preservation, read all source lines through hashline read, wrote verbatim original bytes, then checked destination SHA-256 and byte-for-byte equality against the extracted Git blobs. Upstream parser and tests were not executed.

audit_note: Six exact inputs have individually reviewed full contracts in reviewed-full.json; the other113 positive-title inputs remain pending, including duplicates across sources. All original input/expected bytes, assertion locations, license and hashes remain unchanged. No upstream parser or generator is executed. Whole-source accepted/formal_golden_acceptance/canonical_unit_authorization/coverage_authority remain false. Omitted fields remain unasserted; lexical quality labels are not measurements.
